state:
Goal `core-router-and-4-more`, stage 2 (feature proofs). `Core\Router` and `Core\Router\Match` have every feature proof on disk, and `bun nv proofs --verify --group` says nothing owed for both, with every example and attack ok. `Core\Router\Match` now has a class card, and its five member cards are rewritten in plain words. The `params` card said a capture is still percent-encoded, which was stale: the binary decodes once at the crossing, as `tests/conformance/core/router-match-decodes-each-capture-once-where-it-crosses.nvst` pins.

Its Novis tests are three existing cases that now carry `covers:` markers; its Rust test is `every_match_member_answers_its_own_field_of_the_row` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/router.rs`.

A match for an example or bench comes from `Core\Router::match` (no request needed) or from `Core\Request::route()` with a `.nvsr` beside the program. Inside a loop, bind a narrowed `?Core\Router\Match` to a non-null `Core\Router\Match` variable first (playbook, *Writing a test case*).

`Core\Script`, `Core\Script\ExitReport` and `Core\Secret` are not started.
